steps.title: Resuspend lyophilized primers
steps.instruction: Add 3 nmol of each lyophilized primer to its well in the 96‑well plate (IDT‑supplied) and resuspend to a final concentration of 100 µM as described in the 16S Illumina Primer Plate Resuspension protocol.

steps.title: Aliquot and mix primers to 5 µM
steps.instruction: Aliquot forward (barcoded) and reverse primer pairs into 96‑well working plates and mix to achieve a working concentration of 5 µM each, following the 16S Illumina Primer Plate Aliquoting protocol.

steps.title: Compress primer plates to 384‑well
steps.instruction: Combine the four 96‑well working primer plates into a single 384‑well Echo‑compatible primer plate using a fully interweaved layout as described in the 16S Illumina Primer Plate Compression protocol.

steps.title: Compress gDNA plates to 384‑well
steps.instruction: Combine the four 96‑well extracted gDNA plates into a single 384‑well Echo‑compatible gDNA plate using a fully interweaved layout as described in the Extracted gDNA Plate Compression protocol.

steps.title: Dispense PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Dispense the PCR master mix into each well of three replicate 384‑well plates according to the PCR Master Mix Aliquoting protocol.

steps.title: Sub‑microliter dispense primers and gDNA
steps.instruction: Using the Echo 555, dispense sub‑microliter volumes of barcoded forward primers, reverse primers, and gDNA into the corresponding wells of the three 384‑well plates as per the Sub‑microliter Primer and gDNA Dispense protocol.

steps.title: Pool PCR products
steps.instruction: Pool the PCR products from the three replicate 384‑well plates into a single collection vessel following the 3X PCR Replicate Pooling protocol.

steps.title: Seal and store plates
steps.instruction: Seal the plate with storage‑grade aluminum foil and store in a freezer.
